day_local: Talaadada Usbuuca Laba iyo Tobnaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
homily:
Waxaa jira saacado maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan marka qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuusta ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arkeysaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay xadhigga kabaha oo si qaldan u yaalla, ama buug uu Ben dhigay miiska, ama xataa sawirka diyaarad uu sida aadka ah u jeclaa oo weli derbiga sudhan. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'koobka iyo weelka'. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu u sheegayaa Fariisigii: 'Oh, idinka Fariisiyow! In kastoo aad nadiifisaan dibadda koobka iyo weelka, haddana gudaha waxaa ka buuxa dhac iyo shar.' Bal ka feker sawirkaas. Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in waxa ugu muhiimsan ay tahay waxa ku jira qalbiga. Ben, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil leh qalbi nadiif ah. Xusuusnow sida uu u ahaa wiil si dhab ah u jecel dadka kale. Wuxuu ahaa wiil mar walba diyaar u ahaa inuu dadka kale la wadaago waxa uu haysto. Ben wuxuu lahaa qalbi u taagnaa abuuridda, dhisidda, iyo jacaylka. Wuxuu ahaa wiil mar walba diyaar u ahaa inuu dadka kale ku casumo farxaddiisa, ha ahaato ciyaaraha, aviation-ka, ama xataa markuu rabay inuu u huro lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis. Taasi waa 'gudaha' oo nadiif ah.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay ahaayeen kuwo adag. Waxaa jira waqtiyo aad dareemaysaan in xanuunka uu ka weyn yahay iftiinka. Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. Waxaad siiseen Ben jacayl aan xad lahayn, waalidnimadiinuna waxay ahayd hadiyad uu Ben ku koray. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Laakiin waxa gudaha ku jira, sadaqo bixiya, oo bal eeg, wax walba way idiin nadiif noqonayaan.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay sida loo bixiyo. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aaminsan in 'isku daygu uu yahay waxa kaliya ee muhiimka ah'. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya. Waxaad maqli kartaa codkiisa oo leh: 'Baah, waan fiicanahay.' Sida uu aabihiis ku arkay riyadii, Ben wuxuu u muuqday mid caafimaad qaba, xoog leh, oo faraxsan. Taasi waa ballanqaadkii Ilaah.

Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Waayo, xornimada aawadeed ayuu Masiixu inoo xoreeyey; sidaas darteed adkaada, hana u dhiibina mar kale harqoodka addoonsiga.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil xor ah. Wuxuu ku dhex noolaa xoogga Masiixa. Xusuusnow sida uu u ahaa wiil geesi ah, oo mar walba isku dayey inuu wax walba bixiyo. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aaminsan in 'isku daygu uu yahay waxa kaliya ee muhiimka ah'. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel aanay jirin wax xaddidaad ah, meel uu si buuxda ugu dhex nool yahay xornimada carruurta Ilaah.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in weelka naxariista Ilaah uu weli idin sugayo, iyagoo idin xusuusinaya in jacaylku uu weligiis noolaan doono. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeeyey inaad ku jirto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho, oo aad igu xirto naftaada weligaa. Ha ii oggolaan inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Waxaan u baryeynaa wiilkeenna Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu siiyo nabad iyo iftiin weligeed ah.
Waxaan u baryeynaa dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, inuu Ilaah qalbigooda ka tirtiro ilinta, uuna siiyo rajo iyo xoog ay ku sii wadaan nolosha.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, xornimada aawadeed ayuu Masiixu inoo xoreeyey; sidaas darteed adkaada, hana u dhiibina mar kale harqoodka addoonsiga. Aniga, Bawlos, ayaa idiin sheegaya in haddii aad gudniin qaadataan, Masiixu aanu waxba idiin tari doonin. Mar kale waxaan ku celinayaa nin kasta oo gudniin qaata, inuu ku qasban yahay inuu xajiyo sharciga oo dhan. Idinka oo isku dayaya in sharciga lagu xaqdhowro, waxaad ka go'deen Masiixii; waxaad ka dhacdeen nimcadii. Waayo, Ruuxa xaggiisa, xagga iimaanka, ayaannu ku sugaynaa rajada xaqnimada. Waayo, xagga Ciise Masiix, gudniin iyo gudniin la'aan toona waxba ma taraan, laakiin waxaa wax tara oo kaliya iimaanka jacaylka ku shaqeeya.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Rabbiyow, naxariistaadu ha ii timaaddo. Rabbiyow, naxariistaadu ha ii timaaddo, iyo badbaadadaada sidii ballankaagii. R. Rabbiyow, naxariistaadu ha ii timaaddo. Ha iga qaadin erayga runta ah afkayga, waayo rajadaydu waxay ku jirtaa xukummadaada. R. Rabbiyow, naxariistaadu ha ii timaaddo. Waxaan xajin doonaa sharcigaaga mar walba, weligii iyo weligiisba. R. Rabbiyow, naxariistaadu ha ii timaaddo. Waxaan ku socon doonaa xornimo, waayo waxaan raadiyaa amarradaada. R. Rabbiyow, naxariistaadu ha ii timaaddo. Waxaan ku raaxaysan doonaa amarradaada, kuwaas oo aan jeclahay. R. Rabbiyow, naxariistaadu ha ii timaaddo. Waxaan kor u qaadi doonaa gacmahayga amarradaada, oo waxaan ka fikiri doonaa qawaaniintaada. R. Rabbiyow, naxariistaadu ha ii timaaddo.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Markii Ciise hadlay, ayuu Fariisi ku casuumay inuu la cunteeyo gurigiisa. Wuu galay oo wuxuu fariistay miiska si uu wax u cuno. Fariisigii wuu yaabay markuu arkay inuusan dhaqin gacmihiisa ka hor intaan la cunnin. Rabbigu wuxuu ku yiri, 'Oh, idinka Fariisiyow! In kastoo aad nadiifisaan dibadda koobka iyo weelka, haddana gudaha waxaa ka buuxa dhac iyo shar. Doqonyahow! Miyaanu kan dibadda sameeyey sidoo kale gudaha samayn? Laakiin waxa gudaha ku jira, sadaqo bixiya, oo bal eeg, wax walba way idiin nadiif noqonayaan.'

day: Tuesday of the Twenty-eighth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
